snippet.title: Demonschool - Minigames Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Demonschool is a stylish, tactics-based RPG where motion equals action and every move counts. Set in a haunted island university, you’ll guide Faye and her misfit classmates through demon infested encounters, blending Persona-style social links with fast-paced, grid-based combat. Unravel the mystery, build your squad, and survive the semester... If the demons don’t get you first.
